jobs.title: Geospatial Analyst
jobs.description:
At Optum, we are driven to transform health care not just for our own good, but for the greater good. Here, innovation isn't about another gadget, it's about transforming the health care industry. And, with your geospatial technology expertise, you can join us on our mission to help make the health care system work better for everyone.

As part of Optum Technology, you will thrive as you help deliver solutions for Optum and UHG with world class enterprise geospatial technology as a member of the Enterprise Geospatial Analytics team. As a Geospatial Analyst
, you will be a primary contributor in defining the patterns and practices for applying geospatial technology within healthcare. This position will design geospatial solutions to solve healthcare business problems, assist with platform operations and enhancements, and complete geospatial analytics projects and deliverables in partnership with business units. This role requires someone who is a product-minded technologist, proactive, innovative, and collaborative.

Location
: Remote

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office for a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities

Innovate at the intersection of geospatial technology, artificial intelligence (AI/GeoAI) and business market intelligence in support of the development of company products, tools, platforms, and services.
Complete geospatial analytics projects, build deliverables, create marketing collateral, and contribute to knowledge sharing with a geospatial user community.
Apply advanced geospatial analysis techniques to provide insights into healthcare related business problems.
Assist with defining, designing, and building geospatial technology solutions (patterns and practices) to make non-geospatial experts successful with the technology in their day-to-day work.
Assist with building and maintaining geographic data assets from disparate sources through ETL and automation.
Contribute to GIS platform enhancements and assist with automation, operations, and maintenance needs.
Engage with existing and prospective customers (internal), gather business needs, and communicate the value of Enterprise Geospatial Analytics internal product offerings.

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications

2+ years of experience completing geospatial analysis projects and/or geospatial solution engineering
2+ years of experience using geospatial technology, including some or all the following: ArcGIS Enterprise (Portal, Server) or ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Apps Suite and ArcGIS Pro

Preferred Qualifications

Highschool Diploma or GED
Successful completion of at least 4 post-secondary courses in GIS, 2 Esri ArcGIS Certifications, a GISP certification OR 2+ years of equivalent on the job training
Experience with geospatial platform scripting, automation tools and/or web development (Ex: ArcGIS Python API + Jupyter, ArcGIS JavaScript API) including use of AI coding assistants such as copilot, codex or similar
Experience or interest in Data Science, Machine Learning computing and/or the R Statistical package is a plus
Experience with ArcGIS GeoAnalyics Engine, Databricks and/or Snowflake
Experience applying geospatial analytics in the private sector to solve commercial business problems
Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and listening skills
Healthcare industry experience
All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $72,800 to $130,000 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Application Deadline:
This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

jobs.description:
The Role – What You’ll Do

Barr is seeking a GIS specialist to join our team in Seattle. This position involves GIS work including map and figure creation, data formatting and editing, data management, data analysis, and quality control. This person will act as the primary internal consultant for GIS projects in the office where they are based. Responsibilities will include identifying, determining, and communicating GIS best practices and resources to support technical solutions for both internal and external clients.

Project responsibilities may include working with and interpreting aerial photos, performing analysis of both raster and vector data, completing database entries and queries, performing database management, working with internet map applications, coordinating GIS work with other software applications (AutoCAD, Google Earth), and using standard GIS extensions. The person in this position will primarily work on projects for large clients in the fuels and mining industries, working with a variety of teams to provide high-quality GIS products and exceptional client service.

Your Impact – Key Responsibilities

Map and figure creation: develop clear, accurate maps and figures for project reports and presentations using ArcGIS Pro.
Spatial data analysis and development: perform analyses, georeferencing, and digitizing of raster and vector data using standard Esri ArcGIS extensions.
Database management: maintain and organize geospatial databases, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.
Quality control: review and verify data and cartographic outputs for accuracy and completeness.
Collaboration: work closely with project teams and GIS specialists to deliver high-quality results.

About The Opportunity

Hybrid: a hybrid work arrangement may be considered for this position. A hybrid work arrangement refers to splitting time worked between a Barr office and a home office. This position is based out of Barr's Seattle, Washington, office. 
Travel expectation: be willing to travel and periodically adjust personal schedule to meet project needs.

About You – Required Core Competencies

Education: bachelor’s or master’s degree in GIS, geography, environmental science, or a related field.
Software: strong computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Windows OS and Microsoft Office software. Knowledge of and experience with Esri’s ArcGIS for Desktop 10.x Suite and/or ArcGIS Pro and Google Earth.
Working style: strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. Detail-oriented, thorough, and organized approach.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship by Barr, now or in the future.

anticipated range of $65,000–$75,000/year. Compensation will vary based on relevant experience, education, skill level, and other compensable factors. jobs.description:
Job Summary

E-Logic, Inc. is seeking a Planner / GIS Analyst
to support the development of a 25-Year Real Property Master Plan
for the Virgin Islands National Guard.

The Planner / GIS Analyst will develop and organize the project's GIS database, compile and analyze spatial information, map existing conditions and planning constraints, and produce professional maps, graphics, and other visual materials supporting the master planning effort.

The selected candidate will work closely with the Senior Master Planner and multidisciplinary project team to support site assessments, land-use analysis, environmental constraint mapping, facility planning, and preparation of the final master plan.

Key Responsibilities

GIS Database Development

Build and organize an installation GIS database from available source information.
Compile, clean, organize, and manage spatial and non-spatial data.
Develop GIS layers for facilities, land use, infrastructure, transportation, environmental constraints, and other relevant planning factors.
Maintain data quality, accuracy, organization, and metadata.

GIS Analysis & Mapping

Map land-use opportunities and constraints supporting long-range installation planning.
Conduct spatial analysis to support land-use and development recommendations.
Analyze existing conditions and spatial relationships among facilities, infrastructure, environmental resources, and development areas.
Integrate GIS information with planning, facility, environmental, and infrastructure data.

Planning Support

Support installation site assessments and field data collection.
Assist the Senior Master Planner with planning analyses and development recommendations.
Support preparation of Area Development Plans and other planning exhibits.
Provide GIS analysis and mapping support for master planning activities.

Maps & Graphics

Produce professional maps, exhibits, graphics, and figures for master plan deliverables.
Prepare maps for stakeholder presentations, planning workshops, and technical reports.
Develop clear and accurate graphics suitable for inclusion in formal planning documents.
Coordinate GIS information with other technical disciplines and project team members.

Documentation & Quality Control

Support documentation and quality control of GIS-related information included in the final master plan.
Verify spatial data and map products for accuracy and consistency.
Assist with preparation of supporting technical documentation and planning materials.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Geography, GIS, Urban Planning, Environmental Science, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in GIS, planning, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining GIS databases.
Experience mapping land-use and environmental constraints.
Experience producing maps and graphics for planning, engineering, environmental, or similar technical documents.
Proficiency with ArcGIS Pro.
Working knowledge of AutoCAD.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Strong analytical and organizational skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently in a primarily remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with DoD GIS data standards.
Experience supporting military installations, National Guard facilities, federal facilities, or military bases.
Installation master planning experience.
Environmental planning or environmental constraints analysis experience.
Experience integrating GIS with land-use, facility, infrastructure, or real property planning.
Federal or DoD project experience.
Experience in the U.S. Virgin Islands, Caribbean, or similar island environments.

Work Environment & Travel

This position is primarily remote and part-time
. The selected candidate must be comfortable working independently and coordinating remotely with the Senior Master Planner and project team.

Approximately one trip to St. Croix and/or St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands
, is anticipated during the one-year period of performance.

Application Requirements

Candidates should submit a current CV/resume
demonstrating relevant GIS, planning, mapping, federal, military, environmental, or real property experience.

Take Your Environmental Career to the Next Level

Kleinfelder, a Forbes' Top Employer for Engineers in North America, is committed to a people-first culture, technical excellence, and creating opportunities where employees can thrive!

From environmental planning, permitting, remediation, and site characterization to chemical data management and hydrogeology, Kleinfelder offers a variety of services designed to provide technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions. 

Step into Your New Role

Kleinfelder is seeking a Project Level Environmental Professional Engineer or Professional Geologist to work in our Sacramento, CA or Concord, CA office. Candidates must have a minimum of 6 years of environmental experience.

The ideal candidate will participate in and contribute to a diverse range of professional tasks, in the field and office, in our team-oriented environment. The candidate would be able to take a project from the proposal phase through report preparation on the most challenging remediation projects.

Responsibilities:

Perform task management duties on site investigation, remedy selection, and remediation projects across Northern California
Coordinate with and mentor junior-level staff on small to large project and tasks
Lead conversations with private and municipal clients, as well as relevant regulatory agencies
Prepare and peer review project deliverables as needed, including work plans, reports, remedy selection documents, and internal, client, or agency-facing presentations
Guide team members in meeting Kleinfelder’s safety and quality standards
Prepare proposals for small to medium sized projects (<$50,000 to $250,000) with support from senior staff Review RFPs and RFQs, and participate in go/no-go evaluations of identified opportunities.
Manage small to medium sized projects ( Work independently and perform routine, well-defined field and office tasks and analysis under direct supervision by senior team members
Communicate effectively with field/construction contractors
As needed, oversee subsurface drilling investigations to determine the presence and extent of impacts in soil, soil vapor and groundwater
Confirm the quality procedures used by team members when collecting multimedia samples for field and laboratory testing
Assists in performance of hydraulic tests to support hydrogeologic analysis of water resource projects and environmental remediation system design (including groundwater recovery and treatment, de-watering, and hydraulic containment) (as needed)
Prepare designs, reports, and calculations for simple to moderately complex environmental site assessments and remediation type projects (commercial, industrial, and educational facilities, levees, dams, pipelines, electrical facilities, etc.)
Supervise and direct surface and subsurface investigations that employ soil borings, test pits, well installations, well destructions, soil, groundwater, and vapor sampling, aquifer testing, and surface geophysical surveys

Requirements:

6-10 years of related environmental experience – 8+ years highly preferred
BS in Civil or Environmental Engineering or a BS in Geology or other related discipline (e.g., Geophysics, Hydrogeology, Geochemistry, Environmental Geology, etc.)
Collaborative spirit and resourcefulness along with prompt geological and engineering judgment and decision making

Will require enrollment in the medical monitoring program requiring initial and annual physicals and initial and random drug screens
Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test
Valid driver's license with a good driving record and the ability to travel and drive regularly, often long distances
